topic: Data aggregation and session duration calculation
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered several data points and technical issues. First, it was confirmed that calculations for all datasets were updated, specifically focusing on Belgium.

A separate issue regarding the discrepancy in 'Highest Traffic Facilit' between staging and production environments was addressed by noting that the production environment uses an older version with a legacy query.

Later, it was decided to re-aggregate historical data (pre-2020) into the PROD dataset. Previously, aggregation started on January 1, 2020. This addition will ensure continuity of data on the dashboard.

Finally, a detailed discussion regarding the calculation logic for 'session duration' was initiated.
decisions: Historical data (pre-2020) will be added to the PROD dataset aggregation.
A ticket will be created to track the addition of historical data.
action_items: Add pre-2020 data to the PROD dataset.
Follow up on the session duration calculation logic.
